author: TEDx Talks
description:
Stephen Barton revisits a time when video games were dismissed as a waste of time. Drawing from his journey from Hollywood film scoring to blockbuster games, he reveals how gaming has become one of the most powerful storytelling mediums of our time. Yet, beneath that success lies a deeper warning - why is the education system failing to prepare the next generation for this rapidly evolving creative industry?  GRAMMY-winning and BAFTA-nominated composer Stephen Barton has left an indelible mark on the realms of film, television, and video games, boasting a prolific career  over all three mediums. His body of work includes scores for Star Trek: Picard, all twenty-seven seasons of Apex Legends, Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order, Star Wars Jedi: Survivor, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, 12 Monkeys and the entire Titanfall franchise, among numerous others. 

Beyond composing, he actively explores both music in education as well as spatial and immersive music for virtual, augmented, and extended r
title: How I make music for video games | Stephen Barton | TEDxLondonBusinessSchool

author: TEDx Talks
description: At 55, Loren Greiff got fired for saying "yippee." But the real story isn't about a single word, it's about the months of silence that came before it. In this powerful and provocative talk, Loren exposes the cycle of ageism that quietly pushes executives over 40 out of corporate life, and the trade most professionals make without realizing it: visibility for safety. Through her own firing and the stories of executives she's helped reclaim their careers, Loren delivers a sharp truth, we don't age out by living longer, we age out by living smaller. Loren Greiff is a career coach, loud-mouth age advocate and President and Founder of PortfolioRocket. After decades in corporate and executive search, she faced a turning point in 2019 and realized her passion for helping 40+ executives win despite the broken hiring system, the ATS, and their age. In 2020, Greiff founded PortfolioRocket, which has since helped more than 400 executives 40+ transform their careers, lives, and confidence. Now 61
title: I got fired for saying 'yippee'. Ageism loves silence | Loren Greiff | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Are you working with your grief or is your grief working you? After surviving multiple near-death experiences and enduring a year marked by profound loss, Shari Tate came to a surprising realization: death is not just an event that happens at the end of life. It is a recurring part of being human. We experience many deaths throughout our lives and with each death comes grief.

Through the lens of a writer, this deeply moving talk explores a powerful new framework for understanding grief: not as a condition to overcome, but as a story to integrate. It reveals how unprocessed grief shapes our relationships, our bodies, and our communities, and how storytelling can help us reclaim our agency and move forward. Shari is co-founder of Rose & Honey Apothecary, a writer and communications professional. Her written works span fiction, poetry, essays, screenplays, and various personal online publications. Shari is a featured poet as part of the global Of Earth and Sky exhibition, has been featu
title: Death is a verb: Integrating grief through story | Shari Tate | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the reason you haven’t found your purpose is because you’ve been looking for it in the wrong place?

For decades, we’ve been told to find our purpose as if it’s hidden somewhere outside ourselves, waiting to be discovered. But what if purpose isn’t something you find at all?

In this poignant talk, Corliss Rassyle challenges one of the most common pieces of self-help advice and offers an eye-opening perspective: purpose is not found—it is recognized and chosen.

Through deeply personal stories about family, motherhood, career transitions, and self-worth, she reveals why so many people spend years chasing fulfillment through achievement, validation, and external success, only to feel something is still missing. This talk is for anyone navigating change, searching for direction, or questioning whether their life truly matters. Corliss Rassyle is an international speaker, best-selling author, personal development coach, podcast host, and CEO. For decades, she chased the tradition
title: Why "find your purpose" is the wrong advice | Corliss Rassyle | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the hardest parts of adulthood aren't signs that you're failing, but proof that you're growing?

At age 23 during the COVID-19 pandemic, Jess Diamond became convinced she was the only one struggling while everyone else seemed to have life figured out. But over time, she discovered a powerful truth: many of the experiences that make us feel isolated in our twenties are actually universal.

In this talk, she explores how social media, isolation, and modern adulthood have convinced a generation that they are alone in challenges that are deeply shared. 

This talk is an invitation to stop hiding and start connecting. Because the moment you stop believing you're the only one struggling is often the moment you finally begin to belong. Jess Diamond is The Adulting Coach, host of the podcast How To Twenty-Something, public speaker, and founder of Jess Diamond Coaching, where she helps college kids and young professionals adapt to the many challenges and transitions that come with adul
title: You're not special, you're just adulting | Jess Diamond | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the stories we refuse to hear reveal more about us than the people telling them?

As a publishing professional, Liza Marie Garcia has spent years helping stories find their way into the world. Along the way, she discovered a troubling truth: many voices aren't ignored because they lack value. They're ignored because they challenge the assumptions, beliefs, and narratives we already hold.

In this talk, she explores how bias shapes the stories we read, the people we choose to listen to, and the conclusions we make before truly understanding one another. The future of publishing isn't just about books. It's about who gets to be seen, who gets to be heard, and whether we're willing to let unfamiliar stories change us.  Liza Marie Garcia founded one of the first professional services firms in the U.S. telecommunications industry at age 27 and has been a business owner for over 24 years. She is the Active Partner of NOW Global Media and COO of CEO Book Publishing.  A 7-time book au
title: How book bias shapes culture without us noticing | Liza Marie Garcia | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the stories we inherit hold the key to solving one of humanity's greatest challenges: the crisis of belonging?

In this thought-provoking talk, Mayuko Fukino-Mayhill introduces the Japanese practice of Densho—the art of receiving and passing on stories with honor and respect. Moving beyond storytelling as entertainment, Densho invites us to become "story stewards," preserving the wisdom, values, and cultural heritage that connect generations and communities.

Through Japanese traditions, personal reflections, and powerful examples from around the world, this talk explores how family stories, ancestral knowledge, and cultural memory can create deeper understanding across borders. By viewing our shared human experiences as a "watershed of wisdom," we can transform isolation into connection and build a stronger sense of global citizenship.

At a time when many people feel disconnected from one another, this inspiring talk offers a hopeful vision for preserving cultural heritage,
title: Becoming global story stewards | Mayuko Fukino-Mayhill | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the biggest obstacle to your success isn't your boss, your coworkers, or your workplace—but you?

After working with organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 100 companies, Alina Doran discovered a surprising pattern: the behaviors that derail careers and damage teams are often invisible to the people exhibiting them. In this eye-opening talk, she introduces "Animal Intelligence" and reveals five aminals that represent a hidden form of self-protection that can quietly sabotage success.

Blending workplace psychology, leadership insights, and real-world examples, this talk explores why people resist change, avoid visibility, seek control, or react impulsively under pressure. More importantly, it shows how greater self-awareness can transform conflict into collaboration, unlock career growth, and create healthier workplaces.

If you've ever wondered why talented people get stuck, why teams struggle, or what might be holding you back professionally, this talk offers a power
title: Animal in the mirror: How smart leaders can tame self-sabotage | Alina Doran | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the secret to surviving caregiving isn’t becoming stronger, but letting go of the idea that you have to do it all?

Millions of adults are caught in the Sandwich Generation: raising growing children while caring for aging parents. Yet few people talk about the hidden grief, resentment, guilt, and exhaustion that come with trying to meet everyone's needs while neglecting your own.

In this deeply personal talk, Lanaire Malone shares how a sudden health crisis transformed her relationship with her mother and forced her to confront an impossible question: How do you care for everyone else without losing yourself?

Through powerful storytelling and practical insights, she introduces a simple but transformative idea: stop stacking capes and start switching them. Because this season of life isn't asking you to do it all. It's asking you to be present. Lanaire Malone is a dynamic speaker, trusted HR strategist, multi-passionate entrepreneur and former D-1 collegiate hurdler. As an en
title: The art of winning in the sandwich generation | Lanaire Malone | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
How often do you celebrate yourself, not for a major achievement, but for simply showing up? In this uplifting talk, Michelle McKown-Campbell challenges the belief that celebration should be reserved for milestones, promotions, and accomplishments. Instead, she reveals how recognizing small, everyday victories can transform confidence, increase engagement, and help us reconnect with who we truly are.

Drawing on history, personal stories, and the simple practice of keeping a "Celebration Jar," she shows how our tendency to focus on what’s missing, unfinished, or imperfect causes us to overlook the evidence of our own growth.

This talk is an invitation to notice the moments that matter, count the wins that often go unseen, and remember that progress is built one micro-win at a time. Michelle McKown-Campbell is a former HR practitioner turned Transformational Speaker, Positive Impact Strategist and founder of Activate the Awesome®, a human-centered company dedicated to helping people r
title: The hidden power of celebration | Michelle McKown-Campbell | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
When you post a photo, whose story are you telling? 

In this compelling talk, photographer Jen Allison shares how the stories we tell through images shape not only how we see others, but how entire communities are understood. From documenting her newborn son’s medical journey to collaborating with Indigenous youth through participatory photography projects, she reveals how cameras can either reinforce stereotypes or create space for authentic voices to be heard.

Exploring visual storytelling, consent, representation, identity, and the power of perspective, this talk challenges us to rethink who gets to tell the story and who gets left out of the frame. In a world flooded with images and social media content, learning to shift the lens may be one of the most important skills we can teach the next generation. Jen is a professional photographer, educator, and keynote speaker who works at the intersection of creativity and courage.  Allison began her career assisting top commercial phot
title: Every image is a decision | Jen Allison | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if changing the world starts long before grand gestures, leadership titles, or global movements, and begins with a single choice?

In this deeply moving talk, Sydney Duarte shares a powerful truth: every moment presents a choice between fear and love. She invites us to explore how our presence, actions, and energy shape every room we enter and every person we encounter.

Drawing from her experiences as an international artist, activist, yoga retreat leader, and community builder, she introduces "La LUZ" (your inner light) and shares how small acts of courage, compassion, and connection can create ripple effects far beyond what we imagine. Through stories of resilience, healing, creativity, and leadership, this talk offers a powerful reminder that meaningful change doesn't begin somewhere else; it begins with how we choose to show up today.

This talk will challenge you to see the extraordinary power hidden within your everyday choices. Sydney Duarte is a globally recognized Mural
title: The impact of choosing differently | Sydney Duarte | TEDxSugar Creek Women

author: TEDx Talks
description: Aarini has been doing art her whole life and learned there is more to this craft compared to what people think.. Aarini is a student at LCJSMS. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Beyond the Frame | Aarini Sarkar | TEDxLCJSMS Youth

description: Anooshka tries tutoring and realizes that there’s a lot more going on behind the scenes Anooshka is a student at LCJSMS. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: How to Ignite the Flame of Learning | Anooshka Sen | TEDxLCJSMS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: Lizzy is passionate about saving our oceans. Everyone can help save marine life, even you! Lauren is a student at LCJSMS. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Save Marine Life: For Real This Time | Lauren Mollin | TEDxLCJSMS Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Quantum technology often feels like a distant, abstract concept confined to sci-fi and research labs.  Donston Powell breaks down the abstract barriers to show how quantum is integrating into daily life and why it holds the key to the future of our local industrial landscape.
Videography and editing by ‘F8’, a creative design agency based in Worcester UK. Donston Powell is the Head of Programme Delivery and Strategic Growth at BetaDen, one of the UK's leading technology accelerator programmes. He leads the delivery and growth of initiatives that support ambitious technology startups while building strategic partnerships across industry, academia, investors, and the public sector.
With a background in marketing and innovation, Donston is passionate about emerging technologies including artificial intelligence, quantum technologies, advanced manufacturing, health tech, and robotics. He is a regular keynote speaker, workshop facilitator, and technology advocate, known for making complex
title: The One Where You Understand Quantum | Donston Powell | TEDxWorcester

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Toktam's work is about creating inner freedom from which execution
becomes effortless, discipline becomes identity, and success becomes a natural expression of who you are.
Videography and editing by ‘F8’, a creative design agency based in Worcester UK. Born into instability, immigrating at four, and emancipated by twelve, Toktam Thomas discovered a profound truth: 
We don’t rise once life becomes easier—we rise the moment we stop arguing for our limitations. 
As a mother of two who built a business from inner clarity rather than outer circumstances, she now helps ambitious leaders release the identities that keep them trapped in survival. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Power Of Presence | Toktam Thomas | TEDxWorcester

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Most people think public speaking is about what you do with your hands, or how you stand on the stage, or how you stop your voice from shaking. It isn't. It starts much earlier than that. In this talk, Dave James draws on his years of standing in front of people, a career spent in A&E departments and podiatry clinics, and a deeply personal story about anger and identity, to make the case that speaking is never the problem. What sits underneath it is that most people haven't worked out who they truly are. What you'll get from developing your speaking skills isn't just a better presentation, speech, or talk. It's a much clearer sense of who you are, a deeper connection with the people around you, and being brave enough to say yes before your brain talks you out of it. This is a talk for anyone who has felt like they have something important to share but hasn't quite got around to it.
Videography and editing by ‘F8’, a creative design agency based in Worcester UK. Dave James is a speakin
title: The Power of Public Speaking | Dave James | TEDxWorcester

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What happens when the opportunities that shape your dreams are denied to you?
Growing up in Worcester, Nicole Allison was a football-obsessed girl navigating a game that wasn't built for her. While football taught her resilience, confidence and leadership, it also exposed the barriers facing girls who dared to dream. From being the only girl in boys' teams to watching opportunities available to boys remain firmly out of reach, Nicole experienced first-hand the impact of exclusion.
In this powerful and personal TEDx talk, Nicole explores how those early experiences shaped her determination not just to participate in the game, but to change it. Drawing on her journey from excluded player to owner of Worcester City Women FC, she highlights the importance of creating pathways that allow girls and women to thrive both on and off the pitch.
While celebrating the remarkable growth of women's football and the inspiration provided by the Lionesses, Nicole challenges audiences to consider where
title: The Power of Building What You Were Denied | Nicole Allison | TEDxWorcester

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a world full of noise, distraction, and people waiting for their turn to speak, NHS GP and educator Laurence Quinn argues that listening may be one of the most powerful, and underrated, human skills we have. Through moving, funny, and deeply human stories from both family life and frontline medicine, Laurence reveals why most of us aren’t truly listening… even when we think we are. Blending neuroscience, psychology, and real life encounters, he shares the two essential ingredients behind meaningful connection and the simple questioning technique that can transform conversations, build trust, and even defuse conflict. This talk is a powerful reminder that being heard can change everything.  

Videography and editing by ‘F8’, a creative design agency based in Worcester UK. Laurence Quinn is an NHS GP, medical educator, and creator of the YouTube channel MedMan, where he translates complex medical topics into engaging, easy-to-understand content for the public. Alongside his clinical
title: What 10,000 Conversations Taught Me About Listening | Dr Laurence Quinn | TEDxWorcester

author: TEDx Talks
description:
This talk aims to challenge public perception of Graffiti Art, showing not only an incredible and edgy history spanning decades, but also the extreme skills and passion attached to this vibrant cultural movement. 
Picking apart what makes it unique, compared to other art forms, we’ll also look at the history of tagging, Graffiti Art and its development into Street Art, and ask the question - “where will it go now?” - at a time when mural art has become mainstream.
The aim is that the viewer will go away with an altered perspective, no matter how they feel about it, and can see it as a stand alone, unique, creative scene.
Videography and editing by ‘F8’, a creative design agency based in Worcester UK. Kate Cox is a Neurodivergent (ND) visionary Creative Producer. Not afraid to take risks, Kate has created multiple, highly respected bold projects from conception to reality, including a Street and Graffiti Art festival in Worcester and boundary-pushing, live installation projects at even
title: Painting the Streets - an Artistic Rebellion. | Kate Cox | TEDxWorcester

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if the most important moments of your career never appear on your resume? In this compelling talk, Md. Subail Bin Alam reveals how leadership is not built through titles, awards, or public recognition, but through the difficult decisions made in moments of uncertainty. Drawing from his journey as a KUET alumnus and a pioneer in Bangladesh’s energy and infrastructure sectors, he shares the invisible risks, failures, and acts of courage behind groundbreaking achievements from launching Dhaka’s first gas-driven CNG station to leading world-class renewable energy projects. Through powerful stories and practical insights, he challenges us to stop chasing visible success and start building the character, resilience, and purpose that truly define who we become. With over two decades of experience spanning renewable energy, infrastructure development, and business leadership, he has led pioneering initiatives including Dhaka’s first gas-driven CNG station, the world’s second-largest off-
title: The Unseen Decisions That Forge Real Leadership | Md. Subail Bin Alam | TEDxKUET

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What does a merchant navy officer battling storms in the middle of the ocean have in common with a doctor navigating life-and-death decisions in a hospital? More than we imagine.

Drawing from eight years of experience at sea, Saurav Sarkar explores the striking parallels between life on board a ship and life on the medical frontline. Through stories of uncertainty, crisis management, limited resources, and extraordinary resilience, he reveals how courage is not defined by a uniform but by the ability to stay steady when everything around us is uncertain.

This talk is a powerful reminder that resilience is not built in moments of comfort, but forged in the storms we choose to navigate. Sourav Sarkar is a distinguished Merchant Navy Officer and a passionate motivational and TEDx speaker whose journey mirrors the resilience and precision required in high stakes fields like medicine. Navigating the unpredictable global waters instills a unique discipline that directly parallels the focu
title: Beyond the Uniform: Where Heroes Are Forged | Sourav Sarkar | TEDxBurdwan Medical College

author: TEDx Talks
description: When Chris Bordoni was diagnosed with late-stage cancer at thirty years old, he decided to use this crisis to transform his life. In this thought-provoking talk, he explores how adversity can disrupt old ways of thinking and open the door to personal growth, innovation, and reinvention. Through compelling stories of athletes, businesses, and communities that emerged stronger from moments of collapse, Chris reveals how crises can create possibilities that once seemed unimaginable. This talk is a powerful reminder that while hardship can break us, it can also become the catalyst for profound change.  Chris Bordoni has been many things: All-American athlete, strategy consultant, cancer survivor, entrepreneur, business school professor, husband, and father. The road to the present, however, has been a bit curvier (and rockier!) than Chris would have liked. Starting at age seventeen, Chris unexpectedly began a fifteen-year journey through injuries, illness, and professional setbacks that c
title: Stop Wasting (Good) Crises | Chris Bordoni | TEDxCornell

author: TEDx Talks
description: Andrea Chiș a vorbit despre curajul de a alege adevărul, pe care îl asociază cu autenticitatea și fidelitatea față de propriile valori. Ea a discutat despre importanța de a lua atitudine în fața problemelor din sistemul de justiție și despre decizia de a renunța la poziția sa de profesor la Facultatea de Drept, pe care a descris-o ca fiind un mediu toxic pentru mulți profesioniști din domeniul juridic. Ea a subliniat că integritatea presupune, uneori, alegeri dificile pentru a rămâne în acord cu propriile principii. În viziunea sa, tocmai această sinceritate față de sine și față de ceilalți este cea care poate genera schimbări reale și durabile. Andrea Chiș este fost magistrat și fost profesor al Facultății de Drept din cadrul UBB. De-a lungul carierei sale, s-a implicat activ în dezbateri privind statul de drept, independența justiției și responsabilitatea instituțională. Remarcată pentru rigoarea, claritatea și echilibrul intervențiilor sale publice, Andrea Chiș aduce în spațiul civ
title: Libertatea de a alege adevărul | Andrea Chiș | TEDxAvram Iancu Street

author: TEDx Talks
description: Mara Maniliu a vorbit despre feminism, parcursul său în social media și felul în care a reușit să redefinească gătitul. Ea a arătat cum o activitate asociată mult timp cu rolurile impuse femeilor poate deveni un spațiu al creativității, al pasiunii și al exprimării personale. În viziunea sa, gătitul nu este o obligație, ci o formă de libertate și autenticitate. Mara este, pentru mulți dintre noi, definiția esteticului din online. Un arhitect al experiențelor culinare, care sfidează granițele dintre gastronomie și artă vizuală, transformând fiecare rețetă în adevărate călătorii senzoriale. Într-un univers digital saturat, vocea ei se distinge prin claritate și o eleganță firească. Mara ne învață că modul în care alegem să ne prezentăm aspectele vieții este, în esență, un act de creativitate care ne definește identitatea. Iar când esteticul vine din interior, nu se pot întâmpla decât lucruri cel puțin extraordinare. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but
title: Fata care a schimbat rețeta | Mara Manoliu | TEDxAvram Iancu Street

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if the biggest difference between feeling lonely and feeling at home comes down to just five simple words? Drawing from her own experience moving to four different schools, a young speaker reveals how tight-knit social circles can accidentally lock others out. She challenges us to stop waiting for groups to form naturally and instead intentionally turn them into true communities by extending a single, welcoming invitation. Olivia is a 13-year-old girl who enjoys learning outside just as much as she does inside the classroom. After how many schools she has attended, she learned that all of them have the same goal: growth. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: From Groups to Communities | Olivia Huyck | TEDxClinton Central School

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if a single question in the middle of class could spark a movement that unites hundreds of people? In this inspiring talk, a seventh-grader shares how asking a simple question about food and connection blossomed into "The Longest Table", a massive, student-led community meal for 300 people. By turning chaotic planning into real-world teamwork, they reveal that learning isn't just about getting answers right, but about finding the courage to speak up and lead exactly where you are. Nora is a 13-year old 7th grader in Clinton Central School. She was a student leader in the 2025 CCS Longest Table. In her free time, she enjoys hanging out with her 2 best friends, who are also doing TEDx with her. She has also been in 17 musicals; her favorites include Matilda, Seussical, and Shrek. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Learning Leads to Leadership | Nora Magnarelli | TEDxClinton Central School

author: TEDx Talks
description: Cris Pop a vorbit despre parcursul său în antreprenoriat și despre provocările întâlnite în cariera sa din IT. El a descris experiența într-un mediu corporatist în care performanța și competiția erau adesea puse înaintea oamenilor, lucru care l-a determinat să își caute propriul drum. Discursul său a evidențiat importanța construirii unui mediu în care oamenii sunt apreciați, respectați și valorizați cu adevărat. Cris Pop, fondator Thunder și unul dintre oamenii care cred în povești extraordinare trăite de oameni obișnuiți. Cris este lider și Full Stack Engineer cu o viziune profund ancorată în potențialul uman. El crede în puterea comunităților construite pe valori reale și în leadershipul practicat prin exemplu, serviciu față de ceilalți și conexiuni. Ghidat de convingerea că «dăruind, vom dobândi», Cris îmbină tehnologia și spiritul de comunitate, transformându-le în instrumente de creștere personală și colectivă, inspirând oamenii să creadă mai mult în ei înșiși și în cei din jur.
title: Nu lumea este proiectul tău. Tu ești. | Cris Pop | TEDxAvram Iancu Street

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if your greatest failures are actually the exact moments where your true confidence begins? At just eleven years old, competitive wrestler Honor Smoke shares how a crushing defeat at the State tournament forced her to redefine what it means to believe in herself. By trading the pressure of perfection for the resilience to get back on the mat, she delivers a powerful reminder that real confidence isn't built by winning; it's built by having the courage to try again. Honor Smoke is an 11-year-old trailblazing Indigenous athlete, leader, and role model who is redefining what’s possible for youth in sports. Known for her discipline, resilience, and fearless determination, Honor has made history as the youngest athlete to appear on the cover of Sports Illustrated (March 2025). A NYWAY Girls State Wrestling Champion, she travels across the country pursuing her dreams while balancing academics, leadership, and service. Honor is an honor-roll student at Akron Middle School who hopes to o
title: Don't Confuse Winning with Confidence | Honor Smoke | TEDxClinton Central School

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Šta se može promijeniti za samo godinu dana kada grupa ljudi odluči da prestane da čeka i počne da djeluje? Iva Malešević dijeli priču o građanskom aktivizmu u Risnu i o tome kako su zajedničkim trudom, voljom i inicijativom stanovnici pokrenuli konkretne promjene u svojoj zajednici. Kroz lično iskustvo pokazuje da promjene ne počinju od institucija, već od pojedinaca koji odluče da preuzmu odgovornost za prostor u kojem žive. Ovo je govor o moći zajedništva, građanske inicijative i jednostavnoj, ali često zaboravljenoj istini – ako se mi ne pokrenemo, neće niko umjesto nas. Iva Malešević is an HR leader and organizational development strategist who is redefining the way we understand growth—not merely as a business outcome, but as a process that begins with people.
Through her work in team and organizational development, Iva builds systems where potential is not only recognized but actively nurtured. As an NLP trainer, she helps individuals better understand themselves, take responsi
title: Ako ti nešto ne uradiš - vjerovatno neće niko | Iva Malešević | TEDxPodgorica

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Ideji koja stoji iza Sofi Sove — da učenje govora ne mora da bude klasičan, težak proces, već iskustvo koje može da postane igra.
Kroz priču o razvoju inovativne logopedske aplikacije, ona pokazuje kako tehnologija može da postane most između stručnjaka, roditelja i djece, i kako jedna ideja može da utiče na to da djeca lakše pronađu svoj glas. Ovo je priča o spoju komunikacije, empatije i inovacije, ali prije svega o tome kako rješenja nastaju kada se problemi gledaju iz ugla onih kojima su najvažniji. Marina Ćupić is a communications and strategic development expert with experience in EU projects and social impact initiatives. She is the founder of the company Solutaria and the creator of the startup Sofi Sova, an innovative speech therapy game designed to support children’s language development. Through her work, she connects ideas, people, and solutions that contribute to real-world change. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organ
title: Kada tehnologija progovori jezikom djece | Marina Ćupić | TEDxPodgorica

author: TEDx Talks
description:
U ovom TEDxPodgorica govoru, Milena Đukanović govori o ideji koja stoji u srcu njenog rada — da inovacija nastaje kada se znanje, mašta i ljudskost spoje u istoj tački. Kroz lično iskustvo od akademskog istraživanja do rada sa 3D štampom, ona pokazuje kako jedna ideja može da preraste iz alata za rješavanje krize u platformu za društvenu promjenu, inkluziju i kreativno izražavanje.
Ovo je priča o moći ideja da mijenjaju pravce karijera, industrije i zajednice, ali i o tome da se najveći potencijal često krije u onome što na prvi pogled izgleda kao mali, usputni trenutak. Milena nas podsjeća da ideje ne čekaju savršene uslove — one traže ljude spremne da ih prepoznaju i pretvore u stvarnost. Milena Đukanović is an electrical engineer and designer who, through her brand Printique, combines technology, art, and fashion. title: 3D štampani snovi | Milena Đukanović | TEDxPodgorica

author: TEDx Talks
description:
U ovom TEDxPodgorica govoru „Od takmičara do graditelja budućnosti“, Marko Šćepanović govori o tome kako jedna ideja može da preživi, nestane i ponovo se vrati — i da pritom promijeni i život pojedinca i cijelu zajednicu.
Kroz sopstveni put od učesnika u FIRST LEGO League takmičenju do čovjeka koji ga je ponovo pokrenuo u Crnoj Gori, Marko pokazuje šta se dešava kada se ne odustane od ideje, čak i kada ona nestane iz jednog sistema. Ovaj govor je priča o snazi STEM-a, robotike i obrazovanja da otvore vrata novim generacijama — ali prije svega o tome kako ideja, kada dobije ljude koji u nju vjeruju, može ponovo da oživi i mijenja budućnost. Marko Šćepanović is the national coordinator of the FIRST LEGO League program in Montenegro, a global STEM initiative that inspires young generations through robotics and innovation. A former competitor in European and world robotics competitions, he now helps thousands of children discover the world of technology. His work connects education, creat
title: Od takmičara do graditelja budućnosti | Marko Šćepanović | TEDxPodgorica

author: TEDx Talks
description:
U ovom TEDxPodgorica govoru, Andrija Mujović, osnivač SRMA.me, govori o tome kako se tradicija može sačuvati ne tako što se čuva u prošlosti, već tako što se ponovo oživi u sadašnjosti.
Kroz svoju priču o crnogorskom ručnom radu, zlatovezu i tkanju, on pokazuje kako jedna ideja može da spoji naslijeđe i savremeni dizajn, i kako mladi ljudi mogu postati čuvari kulturnog identiteta kroz preduzetništvo i zanat. Ovo je priča o rukama koje pamte, ali i stvaraju budućnost — i o tome zašto tradicija ima smisla samo kada nastavi da živi. Andrija Mujović is a young craftsman who revives the tradition of Montenegrin folk costumes through gold embroidery, weaving, and handcraft techniques. From an early age, he has explored ornaments, materials, and traditional craft methods, dedicating countless hours to precise, detailed work. His work demonstrates that tradition can be a powerful source of inspiration for new generations. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but
title: Kada tradicija postane budućnost | Andrija Mujović | TEDxPodgorica

author: TEDx Talks
description: Bojana Nikitović govori o svom putu od prostora bivše Jugoslavije do međunarodne filmske scene i Holivuda, kroz ličnu i profesionalnu borbu da izgradi karijeru kostimografkinje u jednoj od najkonkurentnijih industrija na svijetu. Kroz priču o radu na filmovima i serijama poput Marie Antoinette, The Wolfman i Dune: Prophecy, kao i o više od 100 pozorišnih produkcija, ona otkriva kako kostim ne služi samo estetici, već postaje alat za izgradnju likova, emocija i čitavih svjetova. Ovo je govor o upornosti, identitetu i snazi kreativnosti da premosti geografske i profesionalne granice. Bojana Nikitović is a costume designer with a rich international career, and an Emmy nominee for her work on the series Dune: Prophecy. She has worked on projects such as Marie Antoinette, The Wolfman, and Extraction, as well as on more than 100 theatre productions. Her work does not merely follow a story; it actively participates in the creation of worlds on screen and on stage. This talk was given at a TE
title: Sreća prati hrabre | Bojana Nikitović | TEDxPodgorica

author: TEDx Talks
description: Može li startup nastao u zemlji od svega nekoliko stotina hiljada stanovnika da postane globalni tehnološki lider? Kosta Pavlović dijeli priču o DeepMarku – crnogorskom deep-tech startupu koji razvija tehnologiju digitalnih vodenih žigova za dokazivanje autentičnosti sadržaja u eri vještačke inteligencije. DeepMark danas pokušava da iz Crne Gore gradi kompaniju koja može da igra na svjetskoj sceni. Ovo je priča o ambiciji, nauci, upornosti i izazovima stvaranja globalnog proizvoda iz male zemlje – i o tome zašto veličina tržišta ne mora da određuje veličinu snova. Kosta Pavlović is an assistant professor at the Faculty of Natural Sciences and Mathematics and co-founder of the startup DeepMark, where he researches how to preserve the authenticity of digital content in the era of artificial intelligence. His work focuses on AI and digital watermarking as tools for protecting trust in information. Through science and innovation, he develops technologies that help keep the digital world r
title: Kako je juriti jednoroga iz Crne Gore? | Kosta Pavlović | TEDxPodgorica

author: TEDx Talks
description: Success is not only about working hard, but also about knowing when to step forward. Phan Phuong Oanh explores the art of timing and how preparation, patience, and readiness can influence the opportunities we encounter. Phan Phuong Oanh is Miss World Vietnam 2025, representing a journey shaped by discipline, preparation, and persistence. Behind public recognition lies a series of decisions about when to move forward and when to wait. At TEDx UEF 2026, she explores the art of timing and how readiness influences opportunities, growth, and long term success. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Art of Timing: Aligning Yourself with the Right Moment | Phan Phuong Oanh | TEDxUEF

author: TEDx Talks
description: Maybe we do not fear failure itself. Maybe we fear being seen failing. Le Phuong Khanh Nhu explores how public judgment shapes ambition and why redefining failure can help young people grow with more courage. Le Phuong Khanh Nhu is the 1st Runner Up of Miss World Vietnam 2025 and a bilingual MC navigating visibility in highly competitive environments. Through her experiences, she has reflected deeply on pressure and public expectations. At TEDx UEF 2026, she examines why many people fear not failure itself, but the possibility of being seen failing. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: We Don’t Fear Failure. We Fear Being Seen Failing | Le Phuong Khanh Nhu | TEDxUEF

author: TEDx Talks
description: Clear thinking can change the way we learn. Mr. Truong Ky Tong explores how organizing ideas with structure can help people understand better, make better decisions, and navigate complexity with more confidence. Truong Ky Tong is the Founder of Nhà IELTS and an educator dedicated to helping learners approach knowledge with greater clarity and structure. His work focuses on improving not only outcomes, but also the way people think. At TEDx UEF 2026, he examines how organizing ideas effectively can reshape learning, decision making, and the ability to navigate complexity in everyday life. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Resonance | Truong Ky Tong | TEDxUEF

description:
En un mundo lleno de posibilidades, decisiones y distracciones constantes, encontrar aquello que da sentido a nuestro camino puede marcar la diferencia. Patricia Armendáriz comparte una reflexión sobre el “hilo conductor” que guía nuestras acciones, conecta nuestras experiencias y nos acerca a una vida más auténtica. A través de una mirada inspiradora sobre el propósito y la dirección personal, esta charla invita a la audiencia a descubrir qué es aquello que realmente da significado a su historia. Es licenciada en Actuaría por la UNAM, maestra en Economía por la Universidad de Cambridge y doctora en Economía por la Universidad de Columbia.

title: Tu hilo conductor: tu razón de ser | Carmen Patricia Armendáriz Guerra | TEDxAnáhuac Puebla U

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Cuántas veces has pospuesto una idea esperando sentirte completamente listo para empezar?
Durante mucho tiempo pensé que necesitaba tener todas las respuestas antes de dar el siguiente paso. Sin embargo, mi experiencia como emprendedora me enseñó lo contrario: la claridad no es un requisito para comenzar, sino una consecuencia de actuar.
En esta charla comparto cómo el servicio, el contacto con comunidades y la creación de Finara me llevaron a descubrir que el propósito no se encuentra pensando, sino construyéndose a través de la acción. También hablo sobre los retos internos que enfrentamos al perseguir una idea con impacto: el miedo, la incertidumbre y ese diálogo interno que muchas veces nos hace creer que no somos suficientes.
A través de experiencias personales y aprendizajes sobre liderazgo, empatía y emprendimiento con causa, invito a los jóvenes a dejar de esperar el momento perfecto y comenzar a construir aquello que desean cambiar en el mundo.
Porque el propósito no aparece
title: Puede parecer simple  | María José Pérez López | TEDxAnáhuac Puebla U

author: TEDx Talks
description:
En un mundo donde pareciera que nada cambia, donde las injusticias se repiten, las crisis se acumulan y los esfuerzos individuales parecen no hacer diferencia, surge una pregunta incómoda pero urgente: ¿vale la pena hacer lo correcto?
A partir de experiencias personales en contextos de conflicto internacional y en el aula universitaria, esta charla explora cómo, sin importar el entorno, ya sea de escasez o de privilegio, las nuevas generaciones enfrentan una desconexión profunda con su propia capacidad de acción.
Desde conceptos de la psicología social como la indefensión aprendida y la desconexión moral, se analiza cómo la percepción de que “nada cambia” puede llevar a la apatía y a la renuncia silenciosa a la ética personal.
Frente a esto, la propuesta es clara: la transformación del mundo no comienza en grandes discursos, sino en decisiones pequeñas, cotidianas y aparentemente invisibles. Decisiones que, sostenidas en el tiempo, reconstruyen comunidad, fortalecen el tejido social y
title: Exito, excelencia o tracendencia  | Cynthia Jiménez de la Portilla | TEDxAnáhuac Puebla U

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Cuántas veces te quedaste callado por miedo, aunque sabías qué decir? Ariel Goldvarg analiza por qué lo que callamos nos daña y cómo encontrar la voz propia para generar vínculos de confianza.

 Es coach ejecutivo, formador de líderes y especialista en comunicación. Ha trabajado con organizaciones y profesionales de más de 25 países, enfocándose en liderazgo, gestión emocional y habilidades de comunicación. Es autor del libro ¨Oratoria Consciente¨ donde presenta su metodología en la que integra el coaching, la neurociencia y la experiencia escénica. Entrenó a más de 10.000 personas en América Latina, Estados Unidos y Europa. Su trabajo propone desarrollar una forma de comunicar más alineada con la identidad y el propósito. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Ponele palabras | Ariel Goldvarg | TEDxRosario

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Nuestro compromiso global se ha convertido en un simple "like”. Andrés Repetto explora si estamos entrando en una era de deshumanización y cómo encontrar el "hilo dorado" que aún nos conecta. Analista internacional con más de 30 años de trayectoria en medios de comunicación. A lo largo de su carrera, ha cubierto conflictos internacionales, procesos políticos y transformaciones globales, desarrollando un enfoque que combina análisis, contexto y capacidad de síntesis. También ha impulsado proyectos propios en medios digitales, ampliando su alcance y forma de comunicar. 
Actualmente conduce ¨26 Global¨ y ¨26 Planeta Documentales¨ en Canal 26. Su mirada busca ordenar la complejidad global. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Por qué un "like" no es suficiente para salvar el mundo | Andrés Repetto | TEDxRosario
